focus: advisor skill documentation, feature catalogs, and scenario side-effect claims

findingDetails.title: Quoted doctor-command text bypasses skill-first ordering
findingDetails.evidence: The raw substring guard returns the existing ranking whenever '/doctor:' appears; explicit-author phrase evidence also anchors a doctor bridge without distinguishing quoted text at fusion.ts:663-666. Python's explicit-command detector similarly accepts any marker substring at skill_advisor.py:2909-2916.
findingDetails.case: Review the routing taxonomy and explain the quoted example '/doctor:setup'. If the skill and doctor bridge both pass and the bridge ranks first, the substring guard preserves the doctor-first ordering.
findingDetails.recommendation: Distinguish a direct slash-command invocation from a quoted or referenced command before accepting the anchor and bypassing skill-first ordering.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The scorer, explicit-author anchor, and Python bridge matcher are in the configured advisor-code scope.

findingDetails.title: Generic check wording advertises setup on unrelated no-match prompts
findingDetails.evidence: SETUP_WORDING accepts every standalone check inflection; the hook passes the result to fallback rendering at user-prompt-submit.ts:338, and render.ts:547-548 adds the setup hint on a no-match.
findingDetails.case: If 'Check what time the tide turns' receives no advisor recommendation, the predicate is true and the no-match context suggests /doctor:setup.
findingDetails.recommendation: Require setup, environment, installation, or tooling-health context in addition to a generic check verb.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The predicate, its hook call site, and the conditional fallback text were read directly; existing negative coverage uses a no-match prompt without generic setup verbs.

findingDetails.title: Doctor phrase reach can report stale scorer behavior as current
findingDetails.evidence: The script imports the scorer from runtime/dist/runtime at lines 216-219 and only checks existsSync(BUILT_SCORER); no source/build freshness comparison is present.
findingDetails.case: After a current-source scorer change breaks an advertised phrase, a prior but present dist/runtime scorer is imported and can still return STATUS=OK.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a build-freshness check or compare a source/build fingerprint; report the probe as indeterminate when the artifact is stale.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The script is in the configured review scope and doctor-router-reach.yaml invokes it at line 97.

findingDetails.title: Doctor-routing scenarios omit their required feature-catalog backlink
findingDetails.evidence: The playbook authoring contract requires a link to the matching catalog entry when one exists. The seven DOC-385..DOC-391 Source Files sections link to the playbook root and implementation sources but not to scorer-fusion/doctor-command-routing.md.
findingDetails.case: An operator opening DOC-385 directly cannot follow the scenario to the feature contract and its test anchors; they must search the catalog separately. The same gap applies to DOC-386 through DOC-391.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a link to ../../../../feature-catalog/scorer-fusion/doctor-command-routing.md in each scenario's source references.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The contract is at sk-create-manual-testing-playbook/SKILL.md:506, the matching feature leaf exists, and all seven target scenarios were checked.

findingDetails.title: DOC-391 calls the setup run write-free while its advisor leg writes daemon state
findingDetails.evidence: The scenario runs advisor_status --warm-only at line 56. The CLI contract says --warm-only starts or attaches to the daemon; startup opens a writable lease DB, creates its schema, inserts a lease row, and heartbeats it. The package database directory ignores *.sqlite.
findingDetails.case: In a fresh workspace with no running advisor daemon, /doctor:setup starts the advisor and creates or updates its package-local lease database. The ignored database and running process are outside the scenario's git status assertion, so the scenario can pass while it changed persistent runtime state.
findingDetails.recommendation: Describe and verify the daemon/database side effect, or require a pre-warmed isolated advisor instance and define cleanup so the read-only guarantee is accurate.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The documented CLI contract, direct lease acquisition path and database ignore rule confirm the behavior; no runtime probe was needed.

findingDetails.title: The feature catalog lists an OpenCode hook capability without a feature page
findingDetails.evidence: The row names the OpenCode native SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks with prompt-wrapper fallback but says 'No feature file yet.' The authoring contract requires one per-feature reference file for each root-catalog entry.
findingDetails.case: A reader following the current feature inventory to this OpenCode capability has no page to inspect its behavior, source files or validation anchors.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the missing feature page, or merge/remove the row if it is not a distinct shipped capability.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The root is in the review target; the row is at line 126 and the feature-catalog authoring contract is at sk-create-feature-catalog/SKILL.md:12-16.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The pass reviews seven scenario contracts, feature-catalog coverage and cross-runtime documentation, then traces a read-only claim into CLI startup and persistent lease state.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Iteration 3 follows the lead steer's skill-document scope and checks scenario-to-feature traceability, catalog completeness and the claimed no-write behavior against implementation sources.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The new routing scenarios may omit the required reverse link to their matching feature catalog page.

searchActions.queryOrPath: scenario Source Files sections and manual-testing-playbook authoring contract
searchActions.result: All seven DOC-385..DOC-391 files omit the matching feature leaf link; the contract requires it when the leaf exists.

searchLedger.rationale: The missing backlink weakens direct scenario-to-feature traceability across the complete new scenario set.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The read-only setup scenario may start the advisor daemon and write lease state when invoked in a cold workspace.

searchActions.queryOrPath: DOC-391 advisor leg -> --warm-only -> daemon startup -> lease acquire
searchActions.result: The CLI contract starts/attaches to a daemon; startup opens and writes the package-local lease DB, contradicting the scenario's writes-nothing claim.

searchLedger.rationale: The documented cold-start path mutates ignored persistent state that the git-status-only assertion does not cover.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Every current capability listed in the feature-catalog root should have a per-feature page with implementation and test anchors.

searchActions.queryOrPath: hooks-and-plugin root table versus leaf files and catalog authoring contract
searchActions.result: The root catalog names a native OpenCode hook capability and explicitly has no feature page, contrary to the one-leaf-per-entry contract.

searchLedger.rationale: The catalog entry has no source-of-truth feature page, leaving its current behavior and validation anchors untraceable.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The authored documents may have structural or package-reference defects beyond the cross-link findings.

searchActions.result: All seven scenario documents and sampled roots/leaves validate with zero single-file issues; the feature-catalog package validator reports zero violations. The playbook package validator explicitly skips all 61 files as routing-gold roots.

searchLedger.rationale: Single-file structural validators found no format violations; playbook package result is a skip, not a validation pass, and was not used to rule out authoring-contract issues.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No structural issue was found by the applicable single-file validators; the explicit backlink and missing-leaf requirements were evaluated separately and are recorded as findings.
